strategies.name: Range_Stochastic_Divergence
strategies.description: Stochastic divergence detection (14,3).
strategies.why_it_failed: Look-ahead. Divergence detection used a centred rolling window (range_stochastic.py:245,248,281,284), so it read the future. Computed causally it emits ZERO signals. Its reported PF 1.92 / Sharpe 1.07 were fiction.
strategies.what_was_tried: It was the entire live model across four cells until FIX-S1-014. Regenerating the map would NOT have removed it -- the attribution rows derived from look-ahead outcomes, so a fresh vet would have re-qualified it. It is barred by an explicit integrity blocklist checked before the performance gates.

strategies.name: currency_momentum_factor
strategies.description: Currency Momentum Factor — SPEC-currency_momentum_factor.md (CSV row 43).
strategies.why_it_failed: Scored PF 0.89 / Sharpe -0.42 over 300 trades -- but that verdict is on a mutilated version. Its headline mechanism is a cross-pair ranking, and the harness passes one pair at a time with no pair identity, so the rank filter was unreachable and the module degenerated to absolute momentum.
strategies.what_was_tried: Re-measured properly via src/portfolio/ as a portfolio rather than per-cell: full-sample Sharpe 0.07, OOS -0.12. Flat, but it beats the -0.42, which confirms the single-pair scoring destroyed real information.
strategies.next_step: Five currencies leave four active legs (net_tercile_weights sends the median to 0.0) and the published effect is a breadth effect. Needs a wider universe to be a fair test.
